# Recreation Prompt

Create a portrait-first browser endless runner called **Neon Runner: Chad.exe**. Preserve the source mechanics exactly: fixed-position runner, one jump input, gravity, ground landing, scrolling hazards, scrolling collectibles, +10 collectible scoring, speed ramp, AABB hazard failure, game over, and restart. Reinterpret the loop as an after-work vaporwave Y2K internet sprint where Chad.exe or Glow CEO runs across a neon grid, jumps meme firewalls/pop-up ads/cringe blocks, collects gyatt-bytes, and advances through Mall-Net Dawn, AIM Alley, Pop-Up District, Vapor CEO Lane, and Chadtranet Prime. Use browser-native Canvas/CSS, Orbitron/Rajdhani/VT323 catalog fonts, approved remote audio/GIF feedback, vivid synthwave palette, readable HUD, and one-thumb mobile CTA.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is a browser-native canvas endless runner. The player controls a fixed-x runner with one jump action, gravity, ground collision, scrolling hazards, scrolling collectibles, score increments of +10 per collectible, speed increases every 600 frames, collision failure, and restart.

## Protected mechanics
- One-thumb/keyboard jump only; no lateral movement added.
- Gravity `0.8`, jump impulse about `-18`, fixed player lane, bottom ground band, scrolling obstacles/coins.
- Obstacles use AABB collision and end the run.
- Collectibles use AABB collision and add 10 points.
- Game speed starts at 6 and ramps over time.
- Start, fail, restart, HUD score, and mobile jump button flows remain intact.

## Rebuilt direction
Neon Runner: Chad.exe converts the same runner loop into a vaporwave Y2K internet sprint through a neon grid, with Chad.exe/Glow CEO focal avatars, meme firewall hazards, gyatt-byte rewards, after-work arcade onboarding, synthwave city/grid procedural background, catalog-backed fonts, approved remote audio, and compact mobile HUD.
